answer: One simultaneous ceremony per epoch: each identity presents a velvet ribbon at the set minute. A fresh pigment code from a public atlas seals it; the atlas logs minute and code, and late, reused, or doubled ribbons burn the 70-credit bond. First 42, k-th 42+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,039,000 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented-ceremony rings fail: one pigment code, two ribbons in the atlas. Honest agents pay 42 once and keep bond and share.
